_comment: T-719 tutorial-capstone boss 1 — the focus-fire lesson, Warden Aldric's shape at 1/10 scale. Elite chassis (T-294) at MODEST multipliers: stamina 8 => 90 HP x3.7 = 333 (raised from x3/270 on 2026-08-08: combat_ledger 3p clear was 11s, under the 12s trivial floor; now ~13-14s), base_damage 5 x1.2 = 6 every 2.5s (~2.4 dps), so a solo L2 spends ~30s and ~70 HP on it — a real boss fight, not a wipe. enrage is inert (threshold 0). retaliate_only: the side-crypt anchor sits 8m off the gallery pack and 10.8m off boss 2, but proximity aggro would still let a first-time player walk into two fights at once; passing this door must never start the fight, only attacking it does (mob_ai still fully engages on threat, so the encounter is unchanged once pulled). Summons ONE grave husk on a 35s cadence (700 ticks; owner-approved 2026-08-08 after the T-719 balance re-run measured 20s as solo-fatal 2/2 and duo-focus-fire-wipe — each add kill re-armed the summon faster than a duo could burn the boss) at the alcove anchors; adds are temporary and stay dead (instance_service._sweep_dead_temps). render_kind reuses the crypt-ghoul silhouette; mob_id is the unique kill-credit alias shared by q_tut_04 and dungeon_schedule.json.
